Method of Attack: Installs a cryptocurrency miner on victim's computer without consent
Checks for presence of antivirus software and aborts installation if detected
Checks for compatible graphics card and aborts if none found
Creates autorun entry to start miner on user login
Uses 70% of graphics card power for mining
Connects to mining pool at pool50.poolminers.net with username 'miner' and password 'X'
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with compatible graphics cards and no antivirus software installed
